package main import "context" // Page has overloads: an exact match wins, else the one taking ctx. type Page struct{} func (p Page) Label() string { return "plain" } func (p Page) Label(ctx context.Context) string { return "with ctx" } func (p Page) Count(ctx context.Context, n int) int { return n } func (p Page) Count(s string) int { return len(s) }
